rationale: The user explicitly requested a premium dark UI with gold accents, mimicking a luxury automotive feel. The application needs to convey trust, high performance, and exclusivity. The deep midnight blues and gold are tailored for luxury car owners and collectors.

colors.tailwind_config_instructions: Extend Tailwind's theme.colors with specific names: 'vehiq-bg': '#0D0F1A', 'vehiq-card': '#161829', 'vehiq-nav': '#1E2035', 'vehiq-gold': '#C9A84C', 'vehiq-gold-hover': '#E8C96A', 'vehiq-gold-dim': 'rgba(201,168,76,0.15)', 'vehiq-text': '#F4F1EC', 'vehiq-muted': '#6B7090', 'vehiq-border': 'rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.2)'. Disable default light mode entirely in tailwind config using darkMode: 'class' and enforcing dark classes.

usage.h1: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-vehiq-text

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Utilize the 'Control Room' grid for dashboards, ensuring dense but readable data, paired with cinematic large imagery for the virtual garage.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_structure: Left sidebar (fixed, vehiq-nav bg, collapses to icons on mobile). Top bar (sticky, vehiq-bg, contains language switcher, notifications, profile). Main content area (vehiq-bg bg).
layout_and_spacing.garage_grid: Autel diagnostic tablet style. Full-width photo per cell with a bottom-aligned label indicating Make, Model, Year. Hover state: gold border glow + scale(1.02). Use 'grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6'.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Background 'vehiq-card', 1px border 'vehiq-border', no heavy box-shadows. Sharp edges or max 8px border radius (rounded-md/rounded-lg).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use standard Tailwind scale but prioritize generous padding inside containers (p-6, p-8) to avoid text collision with the gold borders.

buttons.primary: bg-vehiq-gold text-vehiq-bg hover:bg-vehiq-gold-hover transition-colors font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-vehiq-gold text-vehiq-gold hover:bg-vehiq-gold-dim transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-2

cards.add_vehicle: border-2 border-dashed border-vehiq-gold text-vehiq-gold bg-vehiq-gold-dim/5 hover:bg-vehiq-gold-dim flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg min-h-[200px] transition-all cursor-pointer

navigation.sidebar_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-md text-vehiq-muted hover:text-vehiq-text hover:bg-vehiq-card transition-colors
navigation.sidebar_item_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-md text-vehiq-gold bg-vehiq-gold-dim transition-colors

charts.theme: Dark background with vehiq-gold (#C9A84C) for bars/lines, vehiq-muted (#6B7090) for axes and grids.

components_strategy.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI components. Inputs with bg-vehiq-bg border-vehiq-border text-vehiq-text focus:border-vehiq-gold focus:ring-1 focus:ring-vehiq-gold.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state. Cards use a subtle -translate-y-1 and a glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(201,168,76,0.3)]) on hover.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' for standard interactions.
motion_and_interaction.garage_card_hover: Hovering over a vehicle card scales the image by 1.02 and illuminates the gold border.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over cards and backgrounds meets minimum contrast requirements.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, links, and key informative components MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='garage-card-porsche').

login_bg.description: Black supercar in dark studio used for the login/registration screen background.
login_bg.usage: Use as a full-cover background image with a bg-black/60 overlay to ensure the login form is legible.

garage_placeholder_1.description: Elegant black sports car for virtual garage preview.
garage_placeholder_1.usage: Use as a default vehicle image in the garage grid.

ai_mechanic_bg.description: Dark tech/engine aesthetic for AI mechanic tab.
ai_mechanic_bg.usage: Use in the background or avatar representation for the AI Mechanic chatbot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup dependencies: Tailwind CSS, React Router, Lucide React, Recharts, react-i18next.
Create strict theme configurations in tailwind.config.js mapping EXACTLY to the provided vehiq-* colors.
Initialize i18n for English (en) and Polish (pl).
Build the specialized 'Autel-style' Garage Grid. Image fills the card, label is an overlay or tight bottom bar containing only Make, Model, Year.
Ensure all dashboard views are responsive, with the sidebar collapsing on mobile devices.
Build out the 5 tabs in the Vehicle Profile: Overview, Service History, Mileage, P&L, AI Mechanic.
For the Admin Panel at /gv91-admin, use a minimal unbranded login screen, followed by a heavily data-dense layout using the vehiq colors.
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx), use JavaScript (.js) as specified in the stack constraints.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all major interactive UI elements.
